title: オンライン会議

style_en: Clean black ink line art with light gray screentone shading, simple expressive faces

characters.name: ユウ

characters.look_en: a young man with short black hair, round glasses and a gray sweatshirt

panels.beat_ja: 在宅でオンライン会議を始める
